# Daily milk

> Daily milk is a free, installable web app that helps a milk delivery business
> keep its day-to-day records and turn them into reports: milkmen, daily milk
> entries, milk rates, purchases, customer payments, and CSV or PDF reports. It
> is an independent personal project run by Rajat Malik. The app needs
> JavaScript and a free account; the pages linked below do not.
>
> The site also publishes free, original guides about record keeping, rates and
> billing, route planning and wastage for milk delivery businesses.

Key facts, all verifiable on the public pages:

- **Price:** the app is free. No paid tier, no trial, no billing or card details
  are taken. The individual public guide articles may display Google AdSense
  advertising; the app, the guides index, the about page and all policy pages do
  not. See `/cookies.html`.
- **What it records:** milkmen (suppliers and delivery staff), daily milk entries
  (quantity, shift and date), milk rates and price lists, purchases, customer
  payments, and reports exported as CSV or PDF.
- **Where data lives:** the business records are stored in Google Firebase
  (Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage) under the user's own account.
  Authentication is handled by Google Firebase Authentication; the app never
  receives the user's Google password.
- **Export and import:** the full database can be exported as a JSON file and
  imported again on another device from the Data Management settings. Exports
  are downloaded directly to the user's device and are never uploaded to a
  shared location owned by the developer.
- **Offline:** the app is a Progressive Web App and keeps working with no
  connection for the screens it has already loaded.
- **Platforms:** any modern browser; installable on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS
  and Linux.
- **Version described here:** 4.0.0.
- **Publishing:** the public guides are written and maintained by the site
  operator, are educational rather than professional advice, and are kept
  separate from advertising. See `/editorial-policy.html` and `/disclaimer.html`.
- **Operator:** Rajat Malik, contact@rajatmalik.dev.

Canonical page: https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/about.html
App: https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/

## Start here

- [About Daily milk](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/about.html): what the app
  does, how data export and import work, where data is stored, who runs it, and
  how advertising is handled.
- [Guides index](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/): every public guide,
  with a one-line summary.
- [Contact](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/contact.html): support, data
  requests, corrections and advertising enquiries.

## Guides

- [How to keep daily milk delivery records](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/milk-delivery-record-keeping.html):
  the seven fields every entry needs, a five-minute daily routine, a 30-minute
  month-end close, and a free daily sheet.
- [How to calculate milk rates and customer bills](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/milk-rate-and-billing.html):
  per-litre and fat-based pricing, worked monthly bills, mid-month rate changes,
  returns, advances and supplier reconciliation.
- [Planning a milk delivery route](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/route-planning.html):
  clustering stops, sequencing, loading in reverse, handling exceptions, and
  measuring whether a change saves time.
- [Reducing milk wastage, returns and shortages](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/milk-wastage-and-returns.html):
  the four kinds of loss, a one-number variance measure, a forecasting rule and
  a returns policy template.
- [Notebook, spreadsheet or app](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/notebook-spreadsheet-or-app.html):
  an honest comparison, backup discipline and a migration plan.
- [Record keeping FAQ](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/faq.html): short
  answers on shifts, rate changes, returns, fat and SNF, backups, offline use and
  exports.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/privacy.html): what is
  stored and why, service providers, advertising cookies, legal bases,
  retention and your rights.
- [Cookie Policy](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/cookies.html): first-party
  storage, Google advertising cookies, consent, and how to control them.
- [Terms of Service](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/terms.html): the rules for
  using the app and the guides, ownership of data, advertising and liability.
- [Disclaimer](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/disclaimer.html): the guides are
  educational, not accounting, tax, legal or financial advice.
- [Editorial Policy](https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/editorial-policy.html): how
  content is written, corrected, and kept separate from advertising.
